newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIAN DLR TRIPS AS DATA REVIVE RATE CUT TALK.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIAN DLR TRIPS AS DATA REVIVE RATE CUT TALK.

text.p: The Australian dollar posted its first lower local close this week after selling from its morning highs was compounded by unexpected weakness in key wages data that left the door open for a sixth cut in interest rates.

After rising to a two week high of US$0.7483 as it continued its impressive recovery from last Friday's two year low of US$0.7295, the market found itself over-extended and under pressure on the data, falling back to US$0.7420 support.
By 4.45 p.m. (0645 GMT) the dollar was stabilising at US$0.7436/41, down on an early US$0.7456/61 and a local close on Wednesday of US$0.7453/58.
